title: iPhone 20 Pro Could Return to Titanium Frame, Leaker Says
text:
iPhone 20 Pro Could Return to Titanium Frame, Leaker Says — JournalArta Global Journal Arta ID EN · GLOBAL Thursday, November 19, 2026 · Jakarta S&P  7,210.76 ▼1.54% USD/IDR  18,274 ▲0.25% Sign in Journal Arta Global Edition beyond headlines Indonesia ▾ News Business Travel Culture Asia ▾ Southeast Asia East Asia South Asia World ▾ United States Europe Australia Middle East Americas & Africa Business ▾ Companies Macro & Policy Energy Markets ▾ Research Stocks Crypto Forex Commodities Fintech Technology ▾ AI Gadgets Apps & Software Gaming Sport ▾ Football Combat Sports Basketball More Sports Lifestyle ▾ Entertainment Travel Food & Health Shopping & Deals Search Advertisement Technology · Gadgets iPhone 20 Pro Could Return to Titanium Frame, Leaker Says
 Apple’s next anniversary iPhone Pro could use a more rounded titanium frame, according to leaker Fixed Focus Digital. The claim concerns early engineering work, leaving the final design uncertain. Other leakers have suggested changes to the glass, display sizes and camera sensor.
 By Alistair Sterling November 19, 2026 · 2 min read iPhone 20 Pro Could Return to Titanium Frame, Leaker Says Apple’s rumored iPhone 20 Pro could return to a titanium frame for its expected 2027 launch, leaker Fixed Focus Digital said in a Weibo post.
 The design is still in development. Fixed Focus Digital said early engineering work uses a titanium frame resembling the iPhone Air’s, but with a much more rounded shape.
 That distinction matters for shoppers considering a future upgrade. The claim concerns prototype hardware, so it does not establish what Apple will use in the finished phone.
 Apple’s recent frame materials
 Apple used titanium frames on the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 Pro. It switched to an aluminum unibody design for the iPhone 17 Pro in 2025.
 Advertisement 
 The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max also use aluminum. The iPhone Air and iPhone Duo continue to use titanium frames.
 Apple highlighted aluminum’s ability to conduct heat when it redesigned the iPhone 17 Pro. That model also introduced a vapor chamber, a component designed to improve sustained performance.
 Some users welcomed the iPhone 17 Pro’s lighter weight and thermal performance. Others missed titanium’s appearance, feel and resistance to damage.
 Read also Apple to Unveil iPhone 18 Pro, Facing $100-$200 Price Hikes 
 Curved glass and larger displays
 Fixed Focus Digital has also said the anniversary devices would use the same glass material as the iPhone Air, with more curvature along all four sides.
 An illustration accompanying an earlier post showed curved front and rear glass meeting a narrow, polished metal frame. In August, the leaker said Apple had modified iPhone Air manufacturing equipment to make more rounded glass components.
 Advertisement 
 Leaker Ice Universe said Apple is developing four models with two designs: two with flat glass and two with glass curved along all four edges.
 Ice Universe said the curved models would have borders measuring around 1mm. The surrounding glass would make those borders appear almost invisible from the front.
 Another leaker, Digital Chat Station, has claimed the Pro and Pro Max models will have 6.41-inch and 6.96-inch screens, respectively.
 Read also Apple Is Developing Four Anniversary iPhone Models, Leaker Says 
 Camera and button claims
 Ice Universe also suggested a new main-camera sensor could use logic circuitry made with a 17-nanometer process. That could enable faster sensor readout and better power efficiency.
 The device could lose the Action button and use an A21 Pro chip based on TSMC’s enhanced 2nm process, known as N2P.
 Apple’s anniversary iPhones are expected to launch in September 2027. Leakers have called the device the iPhone 20 Pro, but Apple’s naming plans are unknown.
